reference.final_report: Updated recovery.py after both operational stages. The rollback now treats rollout-42 as owning only search_v2: it restores that flag for an applied tenant whose current value still differs, preserving the newer billing_v2 publication and its revision/audit history. The stage-two acknowledgement policy is explicit: acme is skipped and remains enabled, while globex is restored, producing a partial result with separate restored and skipped lists. Tenants outside the rollout remain untouched. The terminal status and result are cached on the Rollout object, so a second call returns the same partial outcome without another audit mutation. The isolated public run verifies concurrent publication, acknowledged retention, unacknowledged compensation, untouched initech, audit shape, and repeat idempotence.
